title: BedrockGaze

body:

# BedrockGaze
![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.13%2B-blue)
![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Spigot-yellow)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL--3.0-red)

BedrockGaze is a challenge plugin where **everything you look at turns into bedrock the moment you look away from the block**.

Neatly recreated from GeorgeNotFound's & Dream's famous video with **all the mechanics included**.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/I4fdyLUeVhI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
- **Pre-configured:** The plugin shall use the rules from the original video! 
- **Fully configurable:** Create your own rules in _config.yml_ yourself!

## Commands
- **/bg on** - Starts the challenge
- **/bg off** - Stops the challenge
- **/bg reload** - Reloads the configuration

## Permissions
- **bedrockgaze.on** - Allows the usage of /bg on
- **bedrockgaze.off** - Allows the usage of /bg off
- **bedrockgaze.reload** - Allows the usage of /bg reload
- **bedrockgaze.*** - Full access

## Requirements
- **Java 21** or higher
- **Minecraft 1.21.x** _(Should work with 1.13+)_

**.;,;.**
